stamp_source: data plane, PER BASKET — the newest bar in that basket's own equal-weight level series (baskets[<id>].data_session in the artifact), never the wall clock and never the universe-wide as_of header
idempotency: keep-first per (date, basket_id), where date is the basket's own session — so a basket whose tape did not advance re-derives a key that already exists and the row is refused

era_notes.note: Ledger starts at ship date. Every state shown for an earlier session is a DESCRIPTIVE REPLAY over the committed member tape (engine/us_basket_turn.py --replay), never ledger evidence, and may not be counted as prospective n.

Member coverage is carried per row (members_read/members_total). silver_miners reads 8/10 at ship — MAG and GATO have no store file (W1-C owns that fill). A row scored on a fraction of its basket is not evidence about the basket; read the coverage counts before grading any row.

PRE-FIRST-ROW AMENDMENT (post-merge review of #4924, landed before any production row existed). v1 stamped EVERY basket with a universe-wide max() over the whole US ticker estate, so a basket whose members froze at 2026-07-31 accrued rows dated 08-05/08-06/08-07 carrying byte-identical dd_252 and ret_5d and self-promoted to CONFIRMED on the third — CONFIRMED_MIN_DAYS satisfied by calendar repetition of ONE stale bar — while coverage read 3/3 because it counted store files. Rows are now stamped per basket from that basket's own last level session; keep-first therefore refuses a frozen basket's re-derived row and days_in_state does not advance. NO row in this file was written under the defect: ledger.jsonl did not exist when the fix landed, so there is no quarantine and no era break to read around.

days_in_state is counted only across ADJACENT sessions from this date on: a prior row that does not sit on the basket's immediately preceding available session resets the run-length to 1 instead of counting across the gap. A nightly outage therefore costs a CONFIRMED rather than manufacturing one.

members_read now counts members with a BAR on the row's date; members_with_store carries the older store-file count beside it. Rows written before this note do not exist (see the pre-first-row amendment above), so both fields are on-contract from the first row.
